data.title: Semi-supervised CAPP Transformer Learning via Pseudo-labeling
data.description: arXiv:2602.01419v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: High-level Computer-Aided Process Planning (CAPP) generates manufacturing process plans from part specifications. It suffers from limited dataset availability in industry, reducing model generalization. We propose a semi-supervised learning approach to improve transformer-based CAPP transformer models without manual labeling. An oracle, trained on available transformer behaviour data, filters correct predictions from unseen parts, which are then used for one-shot retraining. Experiments on small-scale datasets with simulated ground truth across the full data distribution show consistent accuracy gains over baselines, demonstrating the method's effectiveness in data-scarce manufacturing environments.
data.author: Dennis Gross, Helge Spieker, Arnaud Gotlieb, Emmanuel Stathatos, Panorios Benardos, George-Christopher Vosniakos
